FIELDS.NAME: Precision Concrete & Masonry Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Precision Concrete & Masonry Solutions specializes in providing high-quality concrete and masonry services for both residential and commercial projects. Our operations include the installation, repair, and restoration of concrete structures such as driveways, patios, foundations, and retaining walls, as well as brick and stone masonry work. We prioritize safety and compliance with all local building codes, ensuring that our projects are executed with the utmost professionalism and attention to detail. Our experienced team is committed to delivering outstanding results while adhering to rigorous safety protocols, including regular worker training and equipment maintenance. We maintain all necessary insurance and engage qualified subcontractors only, ensuring a seamless and well-managed operation on every job site.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any major OSHA violations or incur regulatory penalties, ensuring full compliance with safety standards in the past three years. We confirm that our projects do not involve large-scale demolition or hazardous material abatement without the necessary specialized risk controls, and we maintain active general liability and workers' compensation coverage. Additionally, we operate in full accordance with local permit requirements and building codes, affirming our commitment to compliance at all levels.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 5, 2023, a minor equipment malfunction during a masonry project led to the accidental damage of a neighboring property, resulting in an insurance claim totaling $5,000. The claim was successfully settled and closed in July 2023.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class I, Grade B, Label A
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and on-site watchperson services to enhance safety and deter unauthorized access.
